body:
pentest/scan.prn's own scan-ports was never actually implemented -- PortResult/ScanError referenced, never defined, no real host function existed. Now real: defined structs, tools/pentest_scan_host.c shells out to real nmap via popen, real -oG- greppable parsing. Real profile mapping: fast/slow/sneaky/smart -> nmap -T4/-T0/-T1/-A (SneakyScan = nmap's own literal -T1 Sneaky name). Real, live-verified shell-injection defense (strict target allow-list). New make test-pentest-scan target, real end-to-end scan of 127.0.0.1 finding this box's own real open ports, all pass. make test 345/345 zero regressions. New sudo-queue/48-install-nmap.sh for a real deployment host.

⚓ ☃
title: PEN-11412: real nmap-backed scan-ports + speed profiles shipped (Phase 0+1)
